reference.operation: Unmodified UMD: raw semantic classes/tags/computed properties, root/item/separator textContent and link hrefs, separator and icon nodes. Content records individual trigger/separator fragments with boundary whitespace trimmed; Native retained hidden menu and inter-tag whitespace are excluded from this comparison, while raw source text remains unchanged. Dropdown trigger/link wrapping remains a separate DOM boundary. Parent width=680px/color=rgb(0,0,0), explicit parent dir=profile RTL/LTR. All CSS profiles pass params.id as string 42; omitted props recorded separately.
